meta.title: Countries with high inequality
notes: High inequality = at least the United States' value in 2022 in the same series and measure. PIP series: each country's nearest survey at any distance (either side, ties to the earlier); old = more than 5 years away. WID: the year itself.
171 countries with a national PIP survey. Population: the WID per-capita yardstick at the year. Regions: PIP's seven.
